title: urn:qauth:ia:identifier:v1-rc.0
description: Identifier-first sign-in (ADR-020 §3). Every identifier, known or unknown, gets the same next step, so the screen reveals nothing about which accounts exist (ADR-017 Decision 4). Offered as an alternative of a later step, it is the account switch ("Not you?", "Use another account"): answering it ends the interaction and starts a new one for the same authorization request, and the result is a redirect to the ceremony app’s page of the new interaction. Nothing proved for the first account carries over (#592).

login_hint.description: The identifier: today an email address of at most 254 bytes in UTF-8 (ADR-017 Decision 3). The schema counts characters; the server counts bytes, checks the full email syntax and normalises the address before use.

amr.description: The RFC 8176 `amr` values a successful answer adds to the transaction: none, because the step proves no authenticator.
